cards.headline:
Meta Ray-Ban Display goes
on sale in the UK and Canada
cards.body: Meta Ray-Ban Display is now available in the UK and Canada, with France, Italy and Germany following next month.
cards.mini_headline:
Ray-Ban Display
lands in UK, Canada

blocks.x: Meta Ray-Ban Display is now available in the UK and Canada, and will be available in France, Italy and Germany next month.
Meta is also opening online ordering for the glasses, and they are getting new features and updates.
